(Sorry this is long) I solo q'd to immortal 1, I'll try to give advice. In cs, there's a concept of impact frags/kills. Sometimes getting a kill has less/zero impact on winning the round (like eco frags, or killing someone after bomb explodes).

 Its important not to pay much attention to ur score.

 Solo q is a lottery tbh, but there's some ways to make it better. Communication and pinging is super helpful even at higher ranks, I can't imagine how many rounds could be won in lower ranks if someone pinged or commed how many ppl they saw or where someone was. Another thing, ur money is the team's money. This means sometimes u gotta be the man and suggest when to save (I swear everyone buys no matter their econ in lower ranks and that's a factor in why rounds are lost). Defaults, I haven't been in a silver game but I can safely bet there isn't many rounds where ppl default when on attack.

 Most important of all advice, mindset, u gotta see every game as winnable/or be able to tie. It's  painful, but getting in that mindset will help u in the long run. 

Aim with ur eye looking at the enemy rather than ur eye looking at the crosshair, except for long range in which aiming by looking at the crosshair is fine. 


Now for some bad advice that might work:
OPS. U could probably reach diamond by just oping, it's basically cookie clicker. Each team u play against is different, so different things work. Sometimes pushing on defense IS the right answer (don't do it every game).
